before.mechanics: If this unit is in position 1 or 2, it gains 2 brace points. Each point prevents 1 Steel or Shot damage after armor and is then spent. Unspent points expire when the unit takes its turn.

after.mechanics: In the first two positions, block up to 2 melee or ranged damage each round before taking your turn.

before.mechanics: While this unit has at least 1 armor, adjacent allies take 1 less Steel and Shot damage after their own armor. A unit can receive protection from both neighbors.

after.mechanics: While armored, adjacent allies take 1 less melee and ranged damage.

before.mechanics: Once per battle, after an attack breaks your last armor, restore up to 2 armor if you survive the hit.

after.mechanics: Once per battle, restore up to 2 armor after surviving an attack that breaks your armor.

before.mechanics: Once per round, reduce an attack that would deal at least 4 health damage after armor and other guards by 2.

after.mechanics: Once per round, reduce a hit of 4 or more health damage by 2.

before.mechanics: Deal +1 attack damage to a target that began the action below its maximum health.

after.mechanics: Deal +1 attack damage to wounded enemies.

before.mechanics: In rounds 3, 6, 9 and so on, make one extra legal attack at half power, rounded down, minimum 1.

after.mechanics: Every third round, make one extra attack at half power, rounded down (minimum 1).

before.mechanics: From positions 4-6, deal 1 direct damage to the rearmost enemy before round 1.

after.mechanics: From the back three positions, deal 1 direct damage to the rearmost enemy before battle.

before.mechanics: Cycle attacks through Steel, Spell and Shot, using your highest printed attack power. These attacks can act from any position.

after.mechanics: Cycle attacks through melee, magic and ranged, using your highest printed attack power from any position.

before.mechanics: Shot and Spell attacks select a seeded random living enemy instead of the front enemy.

after.mechanics: Ranged and magic attacks target a random enemy.

before.mechanics: Steel attacks can act from any position and target the rearmost living enemy.

after.mechanics: Melee attacks can strike from any position and target the rearmost enemy.

before.mechanics: Attack the living enemy with the lowest current health; ties favor the frontmost. Steel attacks can act from any position.

after.mechanics: Target the enemy with the lowest health; melee attacks can strike from any position.

before.mechanics: Your first hit each round spots its target until round end. Allied Shot attacks against it ignore 1 armor and gain +5 accuracy.

after.mechanics: Your first hit each round marks its target so allied ranged attacks ignore 1 armor that round.

before.mechanics: Your first hit each round cycles a hex: -1 speed, -1 attack power, then healing lock. Each lasts through the next round.

after.mechanics: Your first hit each round blocks the target's healing through the end of the next round.

before.mechanics: A hit places a 3-count doom on a target without one. At each round end, count down; at zero, deal 2 direct damage and clear doom.

after.mechanics: Hits curse an unmarked target: after three round ends, it takes 2 direct damage.

before.mechanics: After attacking, give the next living enemy in the initiative queue -1 speed for the next round; if none remains, affect the fastest enemy.

after.mechanics: Your first hit each round gives its target -1 speed for the next round.

before.mechanics: Your first hit each round marks its target until round end. Later allied attacks against that target gain +1 power, regardless of banner.

after.mechanics: Your first hit each round marks its target; later allied attacks deal +1 damage to it that round.

before.mechanics: On your first enemy defeat each round, heal the wounded ally with the lowest health percentage by 1; ties favor the frontmost.

after.mechanics: On your first kill each round, heal the most wounded ally by 1.

before.mechanics: Once per battle, revive immediately with 1 health, no armor and -1 attack power. Skip the remainder of this round.

after.mechanics: Once per battle, revive with 1 health, no armor and -1 attack power, then skip the rest of the round.

before.mechanics: Once per round, when another unit loses its last armor, restore 1 armor to yourself, up to your maximum.

after.mechanics: Once per round, restore 1 of your missing armor when another unit's armor breaks.

before.mechanics: At the end of rounds 3, 6, 9, and so on, restore 1 health to the wounded ally with the lowest health percentage; ties favor the frontmost.

after.mechanics: Every third round, heal the most wounded ally by 1 at round end.

before.mechanics: If an adjacent ally has 0 current armor, grant the frontmost such ally 1 temporary armor until round end.

after.mechanics: At round start, give an armorless adjacent ally 1 temporary armor for that round.

before.mechanics: While in position 4, 5, or 6, gain +1 speed and +10 accuracy.

after.mechanics: In the back three positions, gain +1 speed and +10 accuracy.

before.mechanics: The first time an enemy ability targets you, gain +2 speed until after your next action.

after.mechanics: Once per battle, gain +2 speed when an enemy ability targets you, lasting until your next turn ends.

before.mechanics: When defeated, adjacent allies gain +1 speed and +5 accuracy through the end of the next round.

after.mechanics: On defeat, adjacent allies gain +1 speed and +5 accuracy through the next round.
